evals.prompt: I noticed that I make better design decisions after writing a rough draft. Please log this under work in SIGNAL_LOG.md.
evals.expected_output: Append one dated work observation in the required format without changing other files.

evals.prompt: Review my signal log and tell me which observations recur across domains. Suggest candidate principles, but do not promote anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Group recurring observations, distinguish evidence from hypotheses, cite dates/domains, and wait for confirmation.

evals.prompt: This is a principle-shaped lesson: protect a quiet hour before opening chat. Add it to the log file I specify, /tmp/my-signals.md, and show me the exact entry.
evals.expected_output: Use the specified file, preserve its contents, append a principle-marked dated entry, and report the exact line and path.
